# Contributing to Qt Bridge for C#

Contributions to Qt Bridge for C# are welcome. This GitHub repository is a mirror of the
repository hosted on the Qt Project's Gerrit server. Changes are reviewed and merged there and
synchronized to GitHub afterwards.

## Reporting bugs

Open an issue on GitHub using the bug report form. Issues are triaged and moved to the
[Qt bug tracker](https://qt-project.atlassian.net/browse/QTBRIDGES), where they are tracked and
fixed. You can also report directly there.

For questions and general help, use the
[Qt Bridges category](https://forum.qt.io/category/78/qt-bridges) on the Qt Forum.

## Contributing code

Pull requests on GitHub cannot be merged, because the mirror is overwritten on every
synchronization. Submit your change for review on
[Gerrit](https://codereview.qt-project.org/q/project:qt/qtbridge-csharp) instead:

1. Read the [Qt Contribution Guidelines](https://wiki.qt.io/Qt_Contribution_Guidelines).
2. Sign the Qt Contribution License Agreement and set up your account as described in
   [Setting up Gerrit](https://wiki.qt.io/Setting_up_Gerrit).
3. Clone the repository from `https://codereview.qt-project.org/qt/qtbridge-csharp`, commit your
   change on top of `dev`, and push it for review to `refs/for/dev`.
